user.title: Add Labeled Features instance
user.description: One config entry per Labeled Features instance. Most setups need only one; add a second for a testing sandbox with its own disjoint leader label and entity IDs.

data_description.instance_name: Free-form title shown in the UI.
data_description.leader_label: Entities carrying this label participate in this instance. Defaults to `feature_leader` so existing setups keep working.
data_description.features_state_entity_id: Entity ID for the leader/feature state sensor. Leave the default so existing scripts and automations keep resolving it.
data_description.areas_state_entity_id: Entity ID for the areas-registry sensor.
data_description.error_mode_default: Applied as a managed label on the features-state sensor; downstream scripts read it via `labels()`.
data_description.script_call_mode_default: Applied as a managed label on the features-state sensor; downstream scripts read it via `labels()`.
